focus: This is a same-day refresh of W41: fire split its "marketplace hookups beyond eBay" P1 into an Etsy live-run P1 plus two P2s, weekly quota rose from 47% to 58%, and every routine is green (TIRE's 09-30 and RSI's 10-07 catch-ups landed). Five of the six Needs-you findings had already been resolved and are now closed in the ledger, after a live check of branches, dependabot PRs and vigil's checkout. The one left is cloud daily-brief, which still can't reach vigil and needs the host allowlisted on the cloud environment. The local SOTU also points at vigil's old host, and vigil covers only 11 of 17 tracked repos, so that's filed as a stash P1 instead of switched. Start fire's P0 next, the Google Drive backup round-trip verification: it has led the queue for three weeks and blocks the backup rollout. ats-fill's Chrome Web Store release, which failed three more times today, is a close second.
